newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks flat in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks flat in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks were flat in early morning trade on Wednesday, with a firm note carried over from the previous day. Brokers said the Nikkei average was expected to drift narrowly below 21,500 amid a lack of fresh factors to inspire trading.
The key Nikkei 225 average was down 9.68 points or 0.05 percent at 21,196.75 by 0021 GMT. Its December futures were 50 points higher at 21,250.
"The bottom side will remain firm, but stocks will trade narrowly due to a lack of major buyers," said a broker at a major Japanese securities house.
